-- BUDGET MATH
--   The first cube (Bronze) is worth 5 cash. The player starts with 10 cash, so the first buy
--   (Dropper 2, 10 cash) is affordable immediately after claiming a plot. Speed 1 (45 cash) follows
--   after only a short wait (about 9 cubes' worth of income).
--   Total cost of all 10 upgrades:
--     10 + 60 + 45 + 250 + 500 + 900 + 1400 + 2200 + 4000 + 7000 = 16365 cash
--   Income after each milestone (cubes per 2 s cycle x ore value x cash multiplier, per second):
--     base                        1 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   2.5 /s
--     dropper2                    2 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   5   /s
--     tier_silver                 2 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  12   /s
--     dropper3                    3 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  18   /s
--     mult1 (x1.5)                3 x 12 x 1.5 / 2 =  27   /s
--     tier_gold                   3 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  67.5 /s
--     dropper4                    4 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  90   /s
--     mult2 (x2)                  4 x 30 x 2.0 / 2 = 120   /s
--     tier_diamond                4 x 75 x 2.0 / 2 = 300   /s
--   (speed upgrades only shorten the trip to the collector.)
--
-- Effect shapes:
--   { kind = "dropper",  slots = n }   total active dropper slots after purchase
--   { kind = "tier",     tier = n }    ore tier every dropper spits out (index into ores)
--   { kind = "speed",    mult = x }    conveyor speed multiplier
--   { kind = "cashMult", mult = x }    collector cash multiplier

local list = {
	{ id = "dropper2", name = "Dropper 2", cost = 10, requires = nil, effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 2 } },
	{ id = "tier_silver", name = "Silver Ore", cost = 60, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 2 } },
	{ id = "speed1", name = "Speed 1", cost = 45, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 1.5 } },
	{ id = "dropper3", name = "Dropper 3", cost = 250, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 3 } },
	{ id = "mult1", name = "Cash x1.5", cost = 500, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 1.5 } },
	{ id = "tier_gold", name = "Gold Ore", cost = 900, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 3 } },
	{ id = "speed2", name = "Speed 2", cost = 1400, requires = "speed1", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "dropper4", name = "Dropper 4", cost = 2200, requires = "dropper3", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 4 } },
	{ id = "mult2", name = "Cash x2", cost = 4000, requires = "mult1", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "tier_diamond", name = "Diamond Ore", cost = 7000, requires = "tier_gold", effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 4 } },
}

-- Indexed by tier.
local ores = {
	{ name = "Bronze", value = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Silver", value = 12, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Gold", value = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), material = Enum.Material.Foil, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Diamond", value = 75, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255), material = Enum.Material.Glass, sparkles = true },
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	byId[upgrade.id] = upgrade
end

return {
	list = list,
	byId = byId,
	ores = ores,
	-- Starter grant: matches Config.STARTING_CASH so the first upgrade (Dropper 2, 10) is affordable immediately.
	starterCash = 10,
}

-- Hud.client.luau: UI only. Shows Cash and toast messages from the server.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config", 10) :: ModuleScript) :: any

local NumberFormat: any = nil
do
	local nfModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat", 10)
	if nfModule and nfModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, nfModule)
		if ok then
			NumberFormat = result
		end
	end
end

-- All big numbers written to the HUD go through the shared formatter.
local function short(n: number): string
	if NumberFormat and type(NumberFormat.short) == "function" then
		local ok, text = pcall(NumberFormat.short, n)
		if ok and type(text) == "string" then
			return text
		end
	end
	return tostring(math.floor(n))

-- Juice helpers
local function formatCash(n: number): string
	return "Cash: " .. short(n)
end

local popupCounter = 0
local function floatPopup(amount: number)
	popupCounter += 1
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Popup" .. popupCounter
	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	local xOffset = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
	label.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + xOffset, 0.21)
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.05)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)
	label.Text = "+" .. short(amount)
	label.ZIndex = 5

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
	stroke.Thickness = 2.5
	stroke.Parent = label

	label.Parent = gui

	local info = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(label, info, {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + xOffset, 0.15),
		TextTransparency = 1,

	TweenService:Create(stroke, info, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
	task.delay(0.9, function()

	end)

local function pulseCash()
	cashScale.Scale = 1.18
	TweenService:Create(cashScale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

	}):Play()
	cashFrame.BackgroundColor3 = CASH_FLASH_COLOR

		BackgroundColor3 = CASH_COLOR,
	}):Play()
end

-- Cash binding
local lastCash = 0
local firstRefresh = true
local function bindCash(cash: ValueBase)
	local cashAny = cash :: any
	local function refresh()
		local v = cashAny.Value
		if type(v) == "number" then
			cashLabel.Text = formatCash(v)
			if v > lastCash and not firstRefresh then
				pulseCash()
				floatPopup(v - lastCash)
			end
			firstRefresh = false
			lastCash = v
		end
	end
	refresh()
	cashAny:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(refresh)
end

	toastToken += 1
	local myToken = toastToken
	toast.Text = msg
	toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0

	toast.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.78)
	TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75),

	task.delay(2.5, function()
		if myToken ~= toastToken then
			return
		end
		TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			TextTransparency = 1,
		}):Play()
	end)
end

task.spawn(function()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.REMOTES_FOLDER, 10)
	if not remotes then
		return
	end
	local notify = remotes:WaitForChild(Config.REMOTE_NOTIFY, 10)
	if notify and notify:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg: any)
			if type(msg) == "string" then
				showToast(string.sub(msg, 1, 80))
			end
		end)
	end
end)

-- ForgeChecksPlan: pure data describing the live playtest check plan.
-- No services, no side effects. The runner reads `timing`, `checks`, and `counters`,
-- and may call `evaluate` (a pure function) to judge each check.

local Plan = {}

Plan.version = 1

-- 'auto' = rely on the auto-claim fallback; 'gate' = the runner walks onto a claim gate.
Plan.claimMode = "auto"

Plan.timing = {
	settleSeconds = 3,       -- wait after startup before the first observation
	preClaimWindow = 8,      -- observe the plaza before any claim (shorter than the auto-claim delay)
	autoClaimSeconds = 20,   -- spec auto-claim delay (the pre-claim window must stay below it)
	sampleInterval = 2.5,    -- seconds between samples after the claim
	maxRunSeconds = 50,      -- hard cap on the whole run
	minWindowsAfterClaim = 2, -- rising_windows needs at least this many full windows
}

-- ForgeTelemetry counter names the runner bumps (the server runner calls count()).
Plan.counters = {
	passed = "checks_passed",
	failed = "checks_failed",
}

-- Existing counter names, unchanged.
Plan.checks = {
	{ id = "map_built", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "map_built", expect = 1 },
	{ id = "plaza_built", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "plaza_built", expect = 1 },
	{ id = "themes_built", kind = "counter_eq", counter = "themes_built", expect = 6 },
	{ id = "zero_before_claim", kind = "zero_before_claim", counter = "cubes_dropped", expect = 0, guard = "plot_assigned" },
	{ id = "plot_assigned", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "plot_assigned", expect = 1 },
	{ id = "auto_claims", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "auto_claims", expect = 1, mode = "auto" },
	{
		id = "cubes_dropped_rising",
		kind = "rising_windows",
		counter = "cubes_dropped",
		-- minGrowth per window; a faster rate (Dropper 2 bought) is fine, so there is no upper bound.
		expect = { minGrowth = 1, windowSeconds = 2.5, maxGrowth = math.huge },
	},
	{ id = "cubes_collected", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "cubes_collected", expect = 1 },
	{ id = "cashin_fx_sent", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "cashin_fx_sent", expect = 1 },
	{ id = "cash_rising", kind = "cash_rising", counter = "Cash", expect = "greater_than_at_claim" },
	{ id = "no_output_errors", kind = "no_output_errors", counter = "output", expect = { errors = 0, warnings = 0 } },
}

local function num(v: any): number
	if type(v) == "number" then
		return v
	end
	return 0
end

-- Pure evaluator. ctx fields:
--   claimMode: string
--   counters: {[string]: number}        final counter values
--   preClaim: {[string]: number}        counter values at the end of the pre-claim window
--   dropSamples: {number}               cubes_dropped sampled at claim time then each interval
--   cashAtClaim, cashNow: number
--   log: { {type: string, message: string} }
-- Returns ok, message.
function Plan.evaluate(check: any, ctx: any): (boolean, string)
	local kind = check.kind
	local counters = ctx.counters or {}

	if check.mode and check.mode ~= ctx.claimMode then
		return true, "skipped (mode " .. tostring(ctx.claimMode) .. ")"
	end

	if kind == "counter_eq" then
		local v = num(counters[check.counter])
		return v == check.expect, string.format("%s=%s expected %s", check.counter, tostring(v), tostring(check.expect))
	elseif kind == "counter_gte" then
		local v = num(counters[check.counter])
		return v >= check.expect, string.format("%s=%s expected >=%s", check.counter, tostring(v), tostring(check.expect))
	elseif kind == "zero_before_claim" then
		local pre = ctx.preClaim or {}
		if num(pre[check.guard]) > 0 then
			return true, "claim already happened before observation; not testable"
		end
		local v = num(pre[check.counter])
		return v == check.expect, string.format("%s=%s before claim", check.counter, tostring(v))
	elseif kind == "rising_windows" then
		local s = ctx.dropSamples or {}
		local windows = #s - 1
		local minWindows = Plan.timing.minWindowsAfterClaim
		if windows < minWindows then
			return false, string.format("only %d windows sampled, need %d", math.max(windows, 0), minWindows)
		end
		for i = 2, #s do
			local growth = num(s[i]) - num(s[i - 1])
			if growth < check.expect.minGrowth then
				return false, string.format("window %d grew %d (<%d)", i - 1, growth, check.expect.minGrowth)
			end
		end
		return true, string.format("%d windows all rising", windows)
	elseif kind == "cash_rising" then
		local a, b = num(ctx.cashAtClaim), num(ctx.cashNow)
		return b > a, string.format("Cash %s -> %s", tostring(a), tostring(b))
	elseif kind == "no_output_errors" then
		local errs, warns = 0, 0
		for _, entry in ipairs(ctx.log or {}) do
			local t = tostring(entry.type)
			if string.find(t, "Error") then
				errs += 1
			elseif string.find(t, "Warning") then
				warns += 1
			end
		end
		local ok = errs <= check.expect.errors and warns <= check.expect.warnings
		return ok, string.format("%d errors, %d warnings", errs, warns)
	end

	return false, "unknown check kind: " .. tostring(kind)
end

return Plan
